Memorandum of Agreement

Made this day of          , 2025, between the Town of Riverhead, 4 West 2" Street, Riverhead, New York
(‘the Town”) and Civil Service Employees Association, Inc., Local 1000, AFSCME, AFL-CIO, Riverhead Unit of Suffolk
Local #852 having its principal office at 3 Garet Place, Commack, New York (the “CSEA”); and

WHEREAS, the Town and the CSEA are currently parties to a collective bargaining agreement effective January
1, 2023 through December 31, 2025; and

WHEREAS, the civil service job title “Homemaker” is currently being used for certain employees employed at
the Riverhead Town Seniors Center; and

WHEREAS, in 2021 through resolution 2021-421, the Town and the Union entered into an agreement to
reassign the title of “Homemaker” from Group C to Group D of the CSEA Clerical and Supervisory Salary Schedule
effective June 28, 2021.

WHEREAS, due to the need to remain competitive as an employer, it is the desire of both the Town and the
CSEA to re-evaluate the placement of the title “Homemaker” within the structure of the CSEA Supervisory Salary
Schedule.

NOW, THEREFORE, it is mutually agreed as follows:
1.        The title “Homemaker” shall be reassigned from Group D to Group 2 of the CSEA Clerical and Supervisory
Salary Schedule effective pay period following the complete ratification of this agreement.
2.         As a result of Section 1, the following salary adjustments shall be made:

a. Magdalena Lagun’s hourly wage will be increased from $18.9790 per hour to $20.5789 per hour;

b. Lisa Liggon’s hourly wage will be increased from $18.50 per hour to $19.50 per hour;
a.          This stipulation constitutes the entirety of the parties' agreement herein.

,        now or in the future and shall remain specific to this matter.

Local #852 having its principal office at 3 Garet Place, Commack, New York (the “CSEA”); and

WHEREAS, the Town and the CSEA are currently parties to a collective bargaining agreement effective January
1, 2023 through December 31, 2025; and

WHEREAS, the title of Network & Systems Administrator has been designated as deputy level by the
department of civil service, prompting restructuring of the Department Head’s title to the appropriate title and vacating the
title of Network & Systems Administrator; and

WHEREAS, current Network & Systems Specialist Il, John West, had a reclassification of his position by
Suffolk County Department of civil service to that of Network & Systems Administrator, but, is not on the certified list of
eligibles for the title of same; and

WHEREAS, Suffolk County Department of civil service has earmarked the position of John West as Network &
Systems Administrator; and

WHEREAS, as the Town Board recognizes that John West is working outside of his current job title, which
coincides with a specific group on a salary schedule, and agrees that he should be compensated for the duties he is
performing daily.

NOW, THEREFORE, it is mutually agreed as follows:
1.         Employee John West will remain in the title of Network and Systems Specialist II until such time he is able to
be appointed as Network & Systems Administrator.
2.        The Town and the CSEA will recognize John West in the title of Network and Systems Specialist II as acting
Deputy of the Information Technology department and will take on all responsibilities of such, while maintaining his
union status.
3.        This agreement will only apply to John West and no other Network and System Specialist II employed by the
Town.
4.       As acting deputy, the salary for John West will be placed at a Group 9 step 8 on the CSEA Administrative

union contract.

Councilwoman Waski offered the following resolution,  
which was seconded by Councilman Rothwell 
 
        WHEREAS, the Water District Superintendent requested to meet with the Town board to 
review the reasons behind excessive turnover of the department, specifically of those individuals 
who leave for a direct competitor (i.e. Suffolk County Water Authority and the Brookhaven 
National Lab); and 
  
          WHEREAS, the Town Board did meet with the Water District Superintendent, Frank 
Mancini, to review and discuss the above, and agreed that the turnover in the Water District 
required immediate attention; and 
  
          WHEREAS, the Town conferred with the Civil Service Employees Association, Inc., Local 
1000, AFSCME, AFL-CIO, Riverhead Unit of Suffolk Local #852 (CSEA), discussing the 
possibility of restructuring the titles within the Water District in the CSEA Operational & 
Technical salary schedule to reflect the knowledge and expertise required to obtain and 
maintain a license from the Department of Health within the Water trade, to which CSEA 
Leadership agreed. 
  
          NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, this Town Board authorizes the Town 
Supervisor to sign the attached Memorandum of Agreement, outlining the title moves of the 
Water District titles; and 
  
          BE IT FURTHER, RESOLVED, all Town Hall Departments may review and obtain a copy 
of this resolution from the electronic storage device and, if needed, a certified copy of same from 
the Office of the Town Clerk.

AGREEMENT FOR THE 2026 VOLUNTARY RETIREMENT INCENTIVE PROGRAM
FOR ELIGIBLE EMPLOYEES (CSEA)
AGREEMENT dated July _, 2026 by and between the Town of Riverhead and the Civil Service
Employees Association, Inc. Local 1000, AFSCME, AFL-CIO, Riverhead Unit of the of the
Suffolk Local #852 (“the CSEA).
WHEREAS, the Town and the CSEA are parties to a collective bargaining agreement covering
the period January 1, 2026 through December 31, 2029 (“the 2026-2029 Agreement”); and
WHEREAS, the Town Board of the Town of Riverhead is desirous of offering a program
incentive for voluntary retirement to certain CSEA Bargaining Unit members eligible for
retirement (“the Incentive”); and
WHEREAS, the CSEA has considered the terms of the voluntary retirement incentive proposal
and finds same to be acceptable and beneficial to Unit members; and
WHEREAS, the Town and the CSEA have negotiated in good faith regarding the terms and
conditions of the Inventive, and have reached agreement on the terms and conditions of the
Incentive, as set forth below.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, the parties
hereby stipulate and agree as follows:
1. ELIGIBILITY:
Any Employee who:
a. Is employed by the Town as of June 1, 2026; and
b. Voluntarily resigns from Town service for retirement purposes effective not later
than October 1, 2026; and
c. Is eligible to and, effective upon his/her resignation from Town service does retire
into the New York State and Local Employees’ Retirement System (“ERS”) as a
fully vested Tier [V member only; and
d. Notifies the Town, in writing and by irrevocable letter not later than September 1,
2026 of the employee’s irrevocable intent to resign from Town service for
retirement purposes effective on or before October 1, 2026; and
e. Has not, as of June 1, 2026, submitted to the Town a letter of intended separation
from employment; and
f. Is not separating from Town service pursuant to any other prior Stipulation,
Memorandum or other agreement with the Town, State-offered incentive or similar
program, or following notification by the Town that the employee is or may be the
subject of formal disciplinary action during the 2026 fiscal year; and
Page 260 of 291

g. Complies with all of the terms and conditions set forth in the Incentive.

2. TERMS & CONDITIONS
Any Employee deemed eligible pursuant to Paragraph 1 hereinabove must:

a. Deliver to the Town Supervisor, not later than September 1, 2026, a duly executed
“Irrevocable Letter of Resignation” in the attached Form. This letter must reference
that resignation from Town service for retirement purposes shall be effective not
later than October 1, 2026 and specifically state the date upon which the eligible
Employee intends retirement to be effective; and

b. Simultaneous with delivery of the “Irrevocable Letter of Resignation” described
above, the eligible Employee must submit a duly executed “Waiver and General
Release of Claims” in the Form attached.

The Incentive is effective only for the time periods set forth herein, with the latest date to
elect to participate in the Incentive being September 1, 2026 and the latest date upon which
to retire pursuant to the Incentive being October 1, 2026.

3. BENEFIT
An Eligible Employee that complies with the Terms & Conditions of the Incentive set forth
hereinabove will receive:

a. A lump sum payment of $12,500.00 (which will be included in the employee’s final
IRS Form W-2 Wage and Tax Statement), minus applicable taxes and withholdings
and paid out, together with any other severance to which the Eligible Employee is
entitled under the terms of the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

4. IMPACT ON OTHER CONTRACT PROVISIONS

a. All other terms and conditions of the parties’ 2026-2029 Agreement will remain
unaltered and in full force and effect except as set forth in this Agreement as it
pertains to Eligible Employees.

b. Pursuant to Article 10 of the 2026-2029 Agreement, Eligible Employees resigning
from Town employment for retirement purposes pursuant to the Incentive program
will only be eligible for Town-provided health insurance in retirement if they
otherwise meet all preexisting legal and contractual eligibility criteria for the
benefit as of the date on which the Eligible Employee’s resignation from
employment for retirement purposes becomes effective.

c. Any alleged dispute, complaint, controversy or grievance related to this Agreement
including but not limited to the documents prepared pursuant to this Agreement is

Page 261 of 291

hereby excluded from grievance and arbitration procedure set forth in Article 8 of
the 2026-2029 Agreement except that any alleged dispute, complaint, controversy
or grievance relating to Article 10 of the 2026-2029 Agreement shall not be so
excluded.
5. RATIFICATION & APPROVAL
The terms and conditions of this Incentive are subject to ratification and approval of the
Riverhead Town Board.
6. INVALIDITY OR ILLEGALITY
If any provision of this Agreement is found to be unlawful, the remaining provisions will
be deemed null and void as if they had never been made, and any monies paid to and/or
the cash value of any benefits received by the Eligible Employee pursuant to the terms and
conditions of the Incentive will be immediately reimbursed to the Town, with interest at
the maximum rate established by law.
FOR THE TOWN:
Dated:
FOR THE CSEA:                                                                                                .
Dated:
